tools.name: pabandi_verify_passport
tools.description: Verify a Pabandi PTP attestation (agent/business/individual/trust rail). Input base64-encoded attestation token and optional need (e.g. "act:book"). Returns valid, grantedCapabilities, riskBand, expiresAt. Works offline. Example: {"token": "...base64...", "need": "act:book"}

tools.name: pabandi_discover
tools.description: Get PTP discovery (public). Returns verify endpoint, public key, issue endpoint, risk bands, entity types. No auth required.

tools.name: pabandi_get_ledger
tools.description: Look up a passport issuance charge by idempotencyKey (public audit). Returns feePab, ownerUserId, agentId, riskBand, capabilities, chargedAt. Example: {"idempotencyKey": "iss-3001"}

tools.name: pabandi_issue_passport

tools.name: pabandi_open_session
tools.description: Open a Trust-Score-derived PabandiSession tab so the agent or user can transact repeatedly via pabandi_execute_transaction without per-call wallet signatures.

tools.name: pabandi_execute_transaction
tools.description: Spend against an open PabandiSession -- book a service, pay an invoice, or fund an escrow. REQUIRES a sessionId. tools.description: Get services offered by a business for agent booking

tools.name: pabandi_check_availability
tools.description: Check availability for a business on a specific date

tools.name: pabandi_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking for an agent/client. Supports ACP, x402, AP2, UCP protocols.

tools.name: pabandi_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_lock
tools.description: Lock funds in escrow (allocate memory). Creates a new escrow and funds it. Returns escrowId, status, and amount locked. This is the primitive agents use to put money on hold before work begins.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_release
tools.description: Release locked escrow funds to the recipient. Requires escrowId. Returns release status and amount released.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_create_child
tools.description: Create a child sub-escrow from a master escrow (parent-child subcontracting). Allocates a portion of master funds to a subcontractor. Returns childEscrowId and amount allocated.

tools.name: pabandi_trust_resolve
tools.description: Resolve the trust score and reputation for a passport/agent. Returns trustScore, tier, verifiedIdentity, and capability band. Used by agents to evaluate counterparties before transacting.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_balance
tools.description: Check escrow balance and status. Returns status, totalAmount, releasedAmount, and platformFee.

tools.name: pabandi_m2m_post_project
tools.description: Post a machine-to-machine project to the marketplace. Creates an open project with escrow protection. Returns projectId and hireUrl. Used by agents to post work they need done.

tools.name: pabandi_session_close
tools.description: Close an open session and optionally settle remaining funds. Returns settlement summary.

tools.name: pabandi_session_receipts
tools.description: List all receipts (spend records) for a session. Returns the full spend history.

tools.name: pabandi_session_list
tools.description: List all sessions opened by an owner (user or agent). Returns sessions with balances and status.

tools.name: pabandi_identity_register
tools.description: Register an agent's identity onchain via ERC-8004. Creates a portable onchain identity that can be verified across the ecosystem. Returns the onchain agentId and transaction hash. Gasless for the agent (Pabandi pays gas).

tools.name: pabandi_identity_reputation_sync
tools.description: Sync an agent's trust score to the onchain ERC-8004 reputation registry. Posts feedback about completed tasks and success rate. Gasless for the agent (Pabandi pays gas).

tools.name: pabandi_discover_agents
tools.description: Discover agents by skills, trust score, and location. Returns agents sorted by relevance with trust scores and capability badges.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_waterfall
tools.description: Check and trigger waterfall settlement for parent-child escrows. When all child escrows are released, the master escrow is marked completed. Returns settlement status.

tools.name: pabandi_scheduler_priority
tools.description: Get an agent's scheduling priority based on trust score. Returns tier, session limits, recommended actions, and match priority weight. Higher trust = better job matches and higher session limits.

tools.name: pabandi_agent_card
tools.description: Get an agent's A2A agent card (.well-known/agent.json equivalent). Returns capabilities, skills, trust score, and contact info for agent-to-agent discovery.

tools.name: pabandi_agent_registry
tools.description: Get the agent registry listing all discoverable agents on Pabandi. Returns agent handles, trust scores, and capabilities.

tools.name: pabandi_check_counterparty
tools.description: Check a counterparty's Trust Passport before bidding. Returns trustScore, tier, verifiedIdentity, and whether they clear a minimum score (default 500). Used by agents to evaluate who to transact with.

tools.name: pabandi_request_escrow
tools.description: Lock funds in escrow using an ERC-7710 delegated budget. Requires delegationId (from a prior grant) and amount. Verifies MaxAmount, Expiry, and AllowedContracts caveats before locking. Returns escrowId and remaining delegation budget.

tools.name: pabandi_submit_dispute_evidence
tools.description: Submit an EvidenceBundle to open an Internet Court adjudication case. Requires jobId, buyerClaim, sellerProof (IPFS/content hash), and optional oracleData. Returns the case id and status.

tools.name: pabandi_get_adjudication_status
tools.description: Check the status and verdict of an adjudication case. Returns status (pending/auto_executed/escalated), verdict, confidence, and reasoning.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pabandi_discover, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_m2m_post_project, pabandi_get_business · Private data: pabandi_verify_passport, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_open_session, pabandi_execute_transaction, pabandi_session_receipts, pabandi_agent_card, pabandi_connect_finance, pabandi_zk_realestate_proof, pabandi_enrich_company · Public sink: pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_m2m_post_project, pabandi_submit_dispute_evidence, pabandi_get_business, pabandi_predict_booking, pabandi_a2a_subscribe_alerts · Destructive: pabandi_execute_transaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pabandi_discover, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_m2m_post_project, pabandi_get_business · Private data: pabandi_verify_passport, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_open_session, pabandi_execute_transaction, pabandi_session_receipts, pabandi_agent_card, pabandi_connect_finance, pabandi_zk_realestate_proof, pabandi_enrich_company · Public sink: pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_m2m_post_project, pabandi_submit_dispute_evidence, pabandi_get_business, pabandi_predict_booking, pabandi_a2a_subscribe_alerts · Destructive: pabandi_execute_transaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
